name: comp-24
title: Clearable Text Input
description: A labelled text field whose right edge holds a small circled-x while it has content. Clicking the cross empties the field, brings back the placeholder and returns the cursor.
use: A single-line field where users often want to start over, such as quick search or a short note.
avoid: Clearing is instant with no undo, so a stray click on the cross loses the whole entry.
a11y: The clear control is a labelled button and the field has a bound label, but nothing announces that the text was wiped. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A small label sits above a rounded dark field on a black stage. While it holds text a faint circled-x sits inside the right edge; when empty, that icon disappears and a grey Type something... placeholder runs from the left.
behaves: Typing fills the field and makes the circled-x appear; clicking it empties the field, restores the placeholder and moves the caret back into the box. The clip hovers the icon, clears to empty, then types Quarterly roadmap.
customise: The label, starting value and placeholder are set in the file; the field and clear-button styling are classes there too.
weight: light: One field and one conditional icon button; no animation at rest.
